name: Quotes & Proposals Outstanding
rule: stage IN ('Proposal sent','Negotiation') AND proposal_age_days > 56 AND no OG2.3 action on this opportunity in last 14 days
default_script: OG2.3 script: 'Where are you on the proposal? I'd love to help.'
notes: Fastest revenue in the system. Excludes mega RFQs from the headline count.

name: Pre-Quote (stalled before a proposal)
rule: stage IN ('Identified','Qualifying','Pre-proposal') AND days_in_stage > 30 AND proposal_sent_date IS NULL
default_script: OG2.4: 'Are you ready for a proposal on the scope we discussed?'

name: Large accounts that can buy more
rule: account.tier IN ('A','B') AND account.service_lines_bought <= 2 -> contacts with strength >= 3 and seniority >= Manager
notes: Resolves to named contacts, not companies.

name: Small / medium that can buy more
Zero Dark 30 / Silent 6+ months (merged at pilot size)
rule: account.track = 'EXPAND' AND contact.relationship_strength >= 2 AND contact_status = 'Active' AND days_since_proactive_touch > 30 (flag 'Silent 6+' when > 180)
default_script: 'I was thinking about you...' - no agenda
notes: Contact-level so it names humans. Split into two lists once the base is >30 accounts.

name: Decreasing revenue
rule: revenue_trend = 'Decreasing' (last 3 months avg < prior 3 months avg by > 15%, or YoY < -15%)
default_script: 'I couldn't help noticing our work together has been coming down...'
notes: Needs revenue_periods. Flag gap; don't block launch.

name: Revenue autopilot
rule: revenue_trend = 'Flat' AND ttm_billed_usd > threshold AND no new service line or programme in 12 months

name: Used to buy, stopped
rule: billed in months -15..-4 AND zero billed in last 3 months AND no Active programme

name: Warm prospects who didn't buy
rule: stage IN ('Lost','Parked') AND closed_date within 18 months AND lost_reason IN ('Timing','No decision','Price') AND primary contact sentiment >= Neutral
default_script: 'Another customer just started something similar - should we revisit?'

name: Cold prospects never contacted
rule: OUT OF SCOPE - LAND / outbound engine
notes: Kept only so nobody adds it.

name: Single-threaded accounts (Acsia addition)
rule: account.tier IN ('A','B','C') AND account.coverage_ratio < 0.10 -> the account's strength >= 3 contacts
default_script: OG4.1: 'Which other programmes here have the same problem?'
notes: Finding 10: 1-3 contacts vs ~30 in the buying committee.

name: Post-milestone call due (Acsia addition)
rule: milestone.actual_date within last 7 days AND post_call_touch_id IS NULL -> programme customer lead
default_script: 'Did everything land okay?' then rDYK + DYK
notes: Most natural Outgrow call for a PM.

name: Renewal window (Acsia addition)
rule: programme.renewal_date within next 90 days AND status = 'Active' -> programme sponsor / customer PM
notes: MBRDI-type renewals are the pivot moment.
